landing_description: A auna ka sau ɗaya. Yi amfani da shi tare da kowane ɗinkin Jaylor. Awonka na ka ne.
claim_description: Shigar da lambar wayarka, za mu tura maka lamba ɗaya ta WhatsApp don tabbatar da kai ne.
whatsapp_message_first: Don kare bayananka, WhatsApp na bukatar ka aiko mana sako tukuna. Danna ƙasa. Zai buɗe WhatsApp da saƙo a shirye don turawa. Lambarka za ta zo cikin wannan hira cikin daƙiƙu.
offline_claim: Haɗa da intanet don neman Fasfo ɗinka.
offline_view: Haɗa da intanet don ganin Fasfo ɗinka.
no_measurements_yet: Babu awo tukuna. Ka nemi duk wani ɗinkin Jaylor ya auna ka ya ajiye a Fasfo ɗinka. Zai bayyana nan da nan idan lambar wayarka ta dace.
share_create_then_send: Ƙirƙiri hanyar haɗi, sannan ka tura masa ta WhatsApp.
share_generate_description: Ƙirƙiri hanyar haɗi da QR code. Kowane shagon Jaylor zai iya duba shi ya samo sabon awonka nan take.
shops_with_access_note: Awo da shago ya riga ya kwafa yana zama a tarihin wannan shago. Kashe raba zai dakatar da kallo ko shigo da bayanai ta wannan hanyar kawai a nan gaba.
share_dialog_instructions: Nuna wannan ga sabon ɗinki, ko ka tura masa hanyar haɗin. Idan ba shi da Jaylor tukuna, zai kai shi yin rajista tukuna.
no_measurements_here: Babu awo da aka rubuta a nan tukuna.
first_measurement_nothing: Awo na farko, babu abin kwatantawa tukuna.
revoke_confirm: Kashe wannan hanyar raba? Ba zai yi aiki da kowane shago ba.
not_used_yet: Ba a yi amfani da shi ba tukuna
verify_error: Wani abu ya faru. Da fatan a sake gwadawa.
session_expired_description: Da fatan a sake tabbatar da wayarka.
